newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo chairman, relatives give up own stake.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo chairman, relatives give up own stake.

text.p: The chairman of South Korea's Hanbo Group and his relatives will hand over their shareholdings of debt-ridden Hanbo Steel Corp to creditor banks, a group spokesman said on Thursday.
He said the group owner and his family would also give up all rights attached to the four million shares.
"The decision was made this morning and it was relayed to our main creditor Korea First Bank," the spokesman said.
Domestic media earlier reported Hanbo's four creditor banks were seeking a buyer for Hanbo Steel, saddled with huge debt.
The Korea Economic Daily reported heads of Hanbo's main creditor banks had agreed not to give additional loans to the company unless its chairman gave up management rights.
Hanbo's main creditors also include the Korea Development Bank, Chohung Bank and the Korea Exchange Bank .
